name: IDEAL's Virtual Electrician Experience (IVEE)
summary: Through IDEAL's Virtual Electrician Experience, you’ll experience a day in the life of an electrician. Interact and get familiar with IDEAL Industries, Inc.’s tools in a virtual jobsite. Troubleshoot and repair wiring on a packaging machine in a realistic on-the-job scenario. Once you’re done, you’ll receive a score based on your performance.
